## ATTEST\_IT\_HOME\_ENV variable

Environment variable name for overriding the attest-it home directory. When set, this takes precedence over programmatic overrides.

**Signature:**

```typescript
ATTEST_IT_HOME_ENV = "ATTEST_IT_HOME"
```
